answer: Per-identity escrow delay. New identities lock 100 credits for 45 days; release requires 5 distinct-counterparty jobs. Abandoned identities forfeit escrow. Attackers pay 100 locked credits per clone plus 45 days and 5 job interactions; honest agents recover escrow via normal trade. The rule holds in a large ocean market. Checks are slow like a glacier survey. On a sparse mesa market, raise escrow value instead of lowering counterparty count.
